name: mm-mcp
description: Read, search and post in Mattermost as yourself or a bot.
long_description: mm-mcp connects an MCP client to one Mattermost server, as the person or bot whose token it is given. It is read-only unless writes are allowed. Then a change others see, such as a post, a reply, an edit, a reaction or a pin, asks you before it acts; following a thread, saving a post, a reminder, a draft only you see and the typing indicator do not.

mattermost_url.title: Mattermost address
mattermost_url.description: The address you open Mattermost at, such as https://chat.example.com.

mattermost_token.title: Token
mattermost_token.description: A personal access token or a bot token. Where those are switched off, leave it empty after logging in once with mm-mcp login --url <address> in a terminal, which keeps your session in the system's credential store.

allow_writes.title: Allow posting
allow_writes.description: Offer the tools that post and change things. Each change others see asks you before it acts, which needs a client that shows MCP elicitation questions; following a thread, saving a post or a draft, reminders and typing do not ask.

elicitation_opt_in.title: mm-mcp asks as well
elicitation_opt_in.description: Your client's own approval of each call decides whether a post or another change others see goes ahead, and mm-mcp checks what each states. Turn this on to have mm-mcp ask you too, through a question your client shows: a convenience where it shows it, not a safeguard, since some clients answer it themselves.

force_human_in_the_loop_in_claude_code.title: Force a human in the loop in Claude Code
force_human_in_the_loop_in_claude_code.description: Not with mm-mcp asks as well: marks each tool that changes what others see so that Claude Code asks a person on every call, whatever its permission mode or rules allow. An agent cannot post on its own while it is on.

mark_ai_generated.title: Mark posts as written with AI
mark_ai_generated.description: Mark every post and edit the model writes with Mattermost's own marker for text written with AI.

download_dir.title: Download directory
download_dir.description: Where save_file writes attachments. Leave it empty for your Downloads directory.

ca_file.title: Certificate authority
ca_file.description: A PEM file of certificate authorities to trust beside your system's, for a Mattermost whose certificate your organisation signed itself. Leave it empty otherwise.

resource_max_mb.title: Largest resource message, in MB
resource_max_mb.description: The most one message carrying an attached file as an MCP resource holds, a binary file counted as its base64. MCP sends a resource whole, and a client drops a message past its own limit, 10 MB for clients built on the TypeScript SDK. A larger one is refused, and read_file or save_file reads it instead. 0 is no limit.
